summary: The Indicated PJM Transmission Owners move to hold their response deadline in the E-7 show cause proceeding in abeyance for 90 days, to November 16, 2026, so they can prepare section 205 filings on cost recovery agreements, new service rates and transparency.
ask: Hold the deadline to respond in abeyance until November 16, 2026, shorten the comment period to five days, and rule by August 10, 2026.

points.point: The Transmission Owners ask for a 90-day abeyance to November 16, 2026 to develop section 205 filings.
points.quote: respectfully move to hold the deadline to respond in the above- captioned proceeding in abeyance for 90 days, until November 16, 2026.

points.point: They expect to file a pro forma cost recovery agreement and rates for flexible and electrically proximate large load services, with penalties for exceeding contractual limits.
points.quote: will contain a pro forma cost recovery agreement(s), as well as rates for new transmission services for “flexible large loads” and “electrically proximate large loads or co-located loads.”

points.point: They say a cost recovery agreement raises open issues, including overlap with bilateral retail agreements and how to set each customer's minimum contribution.
points.quote: the specific mechanism for determining each Eligible Customer’s required minimum contribution.

points.point: They may revise local planning procedures such as Attachment M-3 to meet the order's transparency findings on Network Upgrade costs.
points.quote: considering what, if any, PJM Tariff modifications they will need to include in their own FPA section 205 filing(s) relating to transparency enhancements.

points.point: They ask FERC to rule by August 10 with a five-day comment period.
points.quote: request that the Commission establish a comment period of five (5) days.

throughLine.text: Seeks to move the E-7 60-day show cause deadline to November 16, 2026; FERC granted it on August 14. Describes the cost recovery, rate and transparency filings the Transmission Owners plan.
